testsuite.name: STOMP over WebSocket — a custom wire protocol via a codec

testcase.name: connect, subscribe, send, and receive the broadcast
testcase.system-out: * StompCodec = Java.type('StompCodec') * session = karate.channel('websocket') * = 'ws://localhost:8091/stomp' * = new StompCodec() * session.start() * session.send({ command: 'CONNECT', headers: { 'accept-version': '1.2', 'heart-beat': '0,0' } }) * session.pop().command == 'CONNECTED' * session.send({ command: 'SUBSCRIBE', headers: { id: 'sub-0', destination: '/topic/greetings' } }) * session.send({ command: 'SEND', headers: { destination: '/app/hello' }, body: { name: 'foo' } }) * message = session.pop() * message.command == 'MESSAGE' * message.body.content == 'Hello, foo!'

testcase.name: a receipt confirms the disconnect
testcase.system-out: * StompCodec = Java.type('StompCodec') * session = karate.channel('websocket') * = 'ws://localhost:8091/stomp' * = new StompCodec() * session.start() * session.send({ command: 'CONNECT', headers: { 'accept-version': '1.2', 'heart-beat': '0,0' } }) * session.pop().command == 'CONNECTED' * session.send({ command: 'DISCONNECT', headers: { receipt: 'disc-0' } }) * receipt = session.pop() * receipt.command == 'RECEIPT' * receipt.headers['receipt-id'] == 'disc-0'
